notes: AMHARIC SKELETON, NOT READY TO PUBLISH. Structure copied from the English 1.0.0 bundle so the two stay in step; every value below is still the English text. TWO KINDS OF TEXT LIVE IN THIS FILE AND THEY ARE NOT HANDLED THE SAME WAY. (1) FREE COPY - translate these in place: title, intro, results.*.title, results.*.body, safety_response.*, continue_label, back_label. (2) INSTRUMENT WORDING - do NOT translate: instruction, items[].text and items[].options[].label. These are EPDS. They must be replaced with the validated Amharic version supplied by the clinical lead: a hand translation is no longer the instrument that was validated, and its scores would not be comparable to any published cut-off. Leave `attribution` until the clinical lead confirms how the validated Amharic source is to be cited. Do not touch any `code`, `value`, `index`, `min`, `max`, `status` or `next` field - those are identifiers and scoring, not text. Publish only after sign-off, with scripts/publish_screening_content.py.
attribution: Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale (EPDS). Source: Cox, J.L., Holden, J.M., and Sagovsky, R. 1987. Detection of postnatal depression: Development of the 10-item Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale. British Journal of Psychiatry 150:782-786.
title: How you have been feeling
intro: As you are pregnant or have recently had a baby, we would like to know how you are feeling.
instruction: Please choose the answer that comes closest to how you have felt in the past 7 days, not just how you feel today.

items.text: I have been able to laugh and see the funny side of things

options.label: As much as I always could

items.text: I have looked forward with enjoyment to things

options.label: As much as I ever did
Rather less than I used to
Definitely less than I used to

items.text: I have blamed myself unnecessarily when things went wrong
I have been anxious or worried for no good reason
I have felt scared or panicky for no very good reason
Things have been getting on top of me

options.label: Yes, most of the time I haven't been able to cope at all
Yes, sometimes I haven't been coping as well as usual
No, most of the time I have coped quite well
No, I have been coping as well as ever

items.text: I have been so unhappy that I have had difficulty sleeping
I have felt sad or miserable
I have been so unhappy that I have been crying
The thought of harming myself has occurred to me
